title: Bounded-below derived mates are computed by underived mates and comparison units
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal A',\mathcal B'$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] in a common universe [def-weil-size-convention], with derived localizations [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and bounded-below categories $D^+(-)$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. Assume $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal A'$ have enough injectives, meaning that every object embeds into an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Give additive adjunctions $L:\mathcal B\rightleftarrows\mathcal A:R$ and $L':\mathcal B'\rightleftarrows\mathcal A':R'$ with $L,L'$ exact. Let $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal B'$ and $H:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A'$ be exact additive functors. Write $C(F)$ for termwise application of an additive functor to bounded-below complexes, $D(F)$ for the descent of an exact functor [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], and $Q$ for localization. Use the canonical bounded-below derived adjunctions [lem-trf-bounded-below-derived-adjunction] $D(L)\dashv\mathbf R R$ and $D(L')\dashv\mathbf R R'$, with the right-derived comparison units $\alpha_P:Q C(R)P\to(\mathbf R R)(QP)$ and $\alpha'_{P'}:Q C(R')P'\to(\mathbf R R')(QP')$ [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective]. For any natural transformation $\sigma:L'G\to HL$, let $b:GR\to R'H$ be its underived mate and let $b^D:D(G)\mathbf R R\to(\mathbf R R')D(H)$ be the mate of the termwise-derived transformation $D(\sigma):D(L')D(G)\to D(H)D(L)$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Then for every bounded-below complex $P$ of $\mathcal A$, under the canonical exact-functor localization identifications,
$$b^D_{QP}\circ D(G)(\alpha_P)=\alpha'_{C(H)P}\circ Q(C(b)_P).$$
The natural transformation $\sigma$ need not be invertible, and $H$ need not preserve injectives.

proof.text: Use the explicit construction boundedBelowDerivedSquare. By the fully faithful precomposition identity of [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property], its component at qN is the termwise transformation conjugated by the exact-functor comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. The homotopy composition comparisons for the identity isomorphisms are identities. Postcompose by the H comparison and H applied to the L comparison; their inverse identities give precisely the computed-square hypothesis hθ. No inverse of σ or of a right-derived unit is used.

Apply [lem-trf-computed-bounded-below-square-mate], the already proved source theorem Adjunction.derivedPlus_mateEquiv_app_fac, with the square boundedBelowDerivedSquare σ and the factorization established in step 1. Its conclusion is exactly the displayed mate equation, including both canonical localization comparisons.

lean.note: The upstream derivedPlus_mateEquiv_app_fac takes a derived square and its factorization hypothesis. This module constructs that square canonically for every ordinary transformation by the fully faithful localization preimage, then states its mate formula without those extra inputs. The construction uses the existing termwise composition isomorphisms, with real data throughout.
